body.p: . Clears 's six XT40 errors at their causes; resolves the Proposed item "xslt.h reads the host's in-scope schemas".

item.p: The schema for schema documents compiles beside the built-ins (catalog-005b, catalog-009). XSD 1.1 Part 1 puts the built-in components in every schema (4.2.1, schema(D)), has every processor know them without reading (C.2.1, hard-coded schemas) and counts two top-level type definitions of one name as one component (3.4.6.5, the note on component identity); XMLSchema.xsd calls its xs:anyType "not the real urType, but as close an approximation as we can get". So a global type definition whose name a built-in type already has is that built-in component: the document's own definition is left unnamed, and sch-props-correct.2 does not hold against it. One place: enter_global (src/schema_read.c); other duplicates in the XSD namespace still conflict, and an xs:import of it was already ignored. With it, the built-in xml.xsd that stands in for an import of the xml: namespace the resolver does not deliver is used only when no document of that namespace is there (4.2.6.2: a processor may keep the first import of a namespace; src/schema_assemble.c): XMLSchema.xsd imports it from www.w3.org beside the environment's xml.xsd. catalog-009 passes; catalog-005b fails on its own data (29 of the suite's stylesheets use XSLT 4.0 instructions and attributes, xsl:item-type, method="csv", line-ending, that the catalog's schema-for-xslt40.xsd does not have yet).

A source that does not validate is sxml's answer, not an error of the environment (as-3301, as-3401, match-208, match-209). Their sources give xs:ENTITY attributes the names of parsed entities (<!ENTITY eac "é">). XSD 1.1 Part 1, 3.16.4 String Valid clause 2 requires a declared entity name, an unparsed entity of the document (Part 2, 3.4.11; Saxon's own XSD test saxonData/Id id017.n01 expects invalid without one). sxml's parser reads the internal subset and passes unparsed entities on (src/xml.c), so nothing of the DTD is missing: the right outcome needs no DTD support, and the test cases declare no dtd dependency, so "not run" has no ground in the catalog. The expected results are Saxon's, which does not make the check (report/results_XSLT3.0: pass; no other submission is schema-aware). Validation is part of the processor under test (the validator of xsl:import-schema and the validation attributes), so the XSLT driver judges an invalid source like any dynamic error of the transformation: the assertions decide (an expected error could pass), here "fail" (sxml_xslt_test_judge_invalid_source, tests/xslt/driver/ xslt_execution.c). An environment schema that does not compile stays an error. The QT4 driver has no such case.

validate-items is a row of its own (call_validate_items, src/function_library_schema.c): XSLT's rules are no longer a branch of XQuery's validate, so what links only XQuery's (the JavaScript module) does not carry them. sxml.wasm was 2,001,084 bytes stripped after , over its 2,000,000 budget; now 1,998,723 (696,023 gzipped of 700,000).

xslt.h's in_scope_schemas comment is accepted ('s Proposed item): it documents what the stylesheet does with an existing field of xpath.h's static context (), is additive (a host that passed schemas before had them ignored), matches src/xslt.c and the lowering, and XSLT 4.0 allows it (F.2: an implementation may make schema components available beyond xsl:import-schema). It is what lets a host-validated source and the stylesheet share one schema's types.

Not done: is-id of union and list elements () is not cheap: the element's start event goes to the builders, with its attributes and namespace bindings, before its content; holding it to the end of simple content means holding those and any comments and processing instructions too, and tree.h is frozen (), so no later mark is possible. Left for a sweep that needs it (no test of the suites does).

Measured (release, all four suites with this code at ae616ca): XT40 8,650 passed (was 8,649), 558 failed, 0 errors (was 6), gate rate 8,029 of 8,728; schema-aware XT40 627 of 971; only the test sets as, catalog and match changed, none lost a test; XP40 30,931 and XQ40 41,273, 0 errors; XSD in scope 41,483 of 41,518; slices 198, 147 (XSLT, of 154) and 147 (XSD).
